meta.title: Walls of the Heart
meta.description: You are the only one who is trapped in the past.

units.rawText: So this is the inside of Eosphorus' neural cloud...
units.displayText: So this is the inside of Eosphorus' neural cloud...

spans.text: So this is the inside of Eosphorus' neural cloud...

units.rawText: Unlike what I expected, I see a serene darkness before me.
units.displayText: Unlike what I expected, I see a serene darkness before me.

spans.text: Unlike what I expected, I see a serene darkness before me.

units.rawText: My visual modules are almost completely ineffective; only the sound of my neural cloud running at high speeds indicates just how expansive this place truly is.
units.displayText: My visual modules are almost completely ineffective; only the sound of my neural cloud running at high speeds indicates just how expansive this place truly is.

spans.text: My visual modules are almost completely ineffective; only the sound of my neural cloud running at high speeds indicates just how expansive this place truly is.

units.rawText: If I'm going to break Eosphorus down from the inside, I need to find a way into the depths of his neural cloud.
units.displayText: If I'm going to break Eosphorus down from the inside, I need to find a way into the depths of his neural cloud.

spans.text: If I'm going to break Eosphorus down from the inside, I need to find a way into the depths of his neural cloud.

units.rawText: Just then, I see twinkling, starry points of light at the edge of my vision.
units.displayText: Just then, I see twinkling, starry points of light at the edge of my vision.

spans.text: Just then, I see twinkling, starry points of light at the edge of my vision.

units.rawText: They are as feeble as fireflies, fading in and out of existence in the darkness like they were breathing.
units.displayText: They are as feeble as fireflies, fading in and out of existence in the darkness like they were breathing.

spans.text: They are as feeble as fireflies, fading in and out of existence in the darkness like they were breathing.

units.rawText: That's...
units.displayText: That's...

spans.text: That's...

units.rawText: Before I can take a closer look, a hand suddenly reaches out of the darkness and grabs me, followed by a booming, icy voice that shakes the entire domain.
units.displayText: Before I can take a closer look, a hand suddenly reaches out of the darkness and grabs me, followed by a booming, icy voice that shakes the entire domain.

spans.text: Before I can take a closer look, a hand suddenly reaches out of the darkness and grabs me, followed by a booming, icy voice that shakes the entire domain.

units.rawText: This is not something you should have seen, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: This is not something you should have seen, {교수}.

spans.text: This is not something you should have seen,

units.rawText: Eosphorus!
units.displayText: Eosphorus!

spans.text: Eosphorus!

units.rawText: I immediately back off and draw my weapon, carefully eying my surroundings.
units.displayText: I immediately back off and draw my weapon, carefully eying my surroundings.

spans.text: I immediately back off and draw my weapon, carefully eying my surroundings.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' voice echoes from all around me, showing off his utter control over his neural cloud domain.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' voice echoes from all around me, showing off his utter control over his neural cloud domain.

spans.text: Eosphorus' voice echoes from all around me, showing off his utter control over his neural cloud domain.

units.rawText: You worked very well with Persicaria, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: You worked very well with Persicaria, {교수}.

spans.text: You worked very well with Persicaria,

units.rawText: I did not expect you to use such a fleeting opening to infiltrate my neural cloud... Unfortunately, you will be forever halted here, in front of my neural cloud's firewalls.
units.displayText: I did not expect you to use such a fleeting opening to infiltrate my neural cloud... Unfortunately, you will be forever halted here, in front of my neural cloud's firewalls.

spans.text: I did not expect you to use such a fleeting opening to infiltrate my neural cloud... Unfortunately, you will be forever halted here, in front of my neural cloud's firewalls.

units.rawText: Even if you attempt to use my neural cloud as a breakthrough point, doing so by yourself is nothing but an exercise in futility.
units.displayText: Even if you attempt to use my neural cloud as a breakthrough point, doing so by yourself is nothing but an exercise in futility.

spans.text: Even if you attempt to use my neural cloud as a breakthrough point, doing so by yourself is nothing but an exercise in futility.

units.rawText: I am many things, Professor, but here, I am God. I could wipe you out of existence with a snap of my fingers.
units.displayText: I am many things, Professor, but here, I am God. I could wipe you out of existence with a snap of my fingers.

spans.text: I am many things, Professor, but here, I am
God
. I could wipe you out of existence with a snap of my fingers.

units.rawText: Oh please, I'm not that naive.
units.displayText: Oh please, I'm not that naive.

spans.text: Oh please, I'm not
that
naive.

units.rawText: How many hits can those firewalls of yours take?
units.displayText: How many hits can those firewalls of yours take?

spans.text: How many hits can those firewalls of yours take?

units.rawText: I point my gun toward the voice and shoot. The bullets break through layer after layer of barriers before stopping in mid-air, robbed of their energy and unable to proceed further.
units.displayText: I point my gun toward the voice and shoot. The bullets break through layer after layer of barriers before stopping in mid-air, robbed of their energy and unable to proceed further.

spans.text: I point my gun toward the voice and shoot. The bullets break through layer after layer of barriers before stopping in mid-air, robbed of their energy and unable to proceed further.

units.rawText: A direct neural cloud hacking attack, then... I see. Antonina must have designed it.
units.displayText: A direct neural cloud hacking attack, then... I see. Antonina must have designed it.

spans.text: A direct neural cloud hacking attack, then... I see. Antonina must have designed it.

units.rawText: The leader of the Sanctifiers reaches out and strikes the darkness, making the hitherto invisible barriers appear before me, one after another.
units.displayText: The leader of the Sanctifiers reaches out and strikes the darkness, making the hitherto invisible barriers appear before me, one after another.

spans.text: The leader of the Sanctifiers reaches out and strikes the darkness, making the hitherto invisible barriers appear before me, one after another.

units.rawText: There's a bullet hole visible in them, but they're a long way off from piercing all the way to Eosphorus.
units.displayText: There's a bullet hole visible in them, but they're a long way off from piercing all the way to Eosphorus.

spans.text: There's a bullet hole visible in them, but they're a long way off from piercing all the way to Eosphorus.

units.rawText: Aren't you afraid I'll destroy those firewalls of yours now that you've shown them to me?
units.displayText: Aren't you afraid I'll destroy those firewalls of yours now that you've shown them to me?

spans.text: Aren't you afraid I'll destroy those firewalls of yours now that you've shown them to me?

units.rawText: You are welcome to try.
units.displayText: You are welcome to try.

spans.text: You are welcome to try.

units.rawText: I once dared to hope we could have coexisted peacefully in the future, but reality is cruel and would not let me so choose.
units.displayText: I once dared to hope we could have coexisted peacefully in the future, but reality is cruel and would not let me so choose.

spans.text: I once dared to hope we could have coexisted peacefully in the future, but reality is cruel and would not let me so choose.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, your skin will be much more useful than your will ever would.
units.displayText: {교수}, your skin will be much more useful than your will ever would.

spans.text: , your skin will be much more useful than your will ever would.

units.rawText: Deafening alarms ring out around me, and the darkness within my line of sight shudders and shrinks.
units.displayText: Deafening alarms ring out around me, and the darkness within my line of sight shudders and shrinks.

spans.text: Deafening alarms ring out around me, and the darkness within my line of sight shudders and shrinks.

units.rawText: Starlight attacks me from all sides, tearing through my meager operand shields at the command of Magrasea's new king.
units.displayText: Starlight attacks me from all sides, tearing through my meager operand shields at the command of Magrasea's new king.

spans.text: Starlight attacks me from all sides, tearing through my meager operand shields at the command of Magrasea's new king.

units.rawText: Guh!
units.displayText: Guh!

spans.text: Guh!

units.rawText: I will destroy your neural cloud here, <cmdr>. Defeated, you will be nothing but an empty shell.
units.displayText: I will destroy your neural cloud here, {교수}. Defeated, you will be nothing but an empty shell.

spans.text: I will destroy your neural cloud here,
. Defeated, you will be nothing but an empty shell.

units.rawText: There is no more suitable gift for deceiving the gods than that!
units.displayText: There is no more suitable gift for deceiving the gods than that!

spans.text: There is no more suitable gift for deceiving the gods than that!

units.rawText: My response is a gunshot as I reflexively dodge and roll to avoid the counterattacks from the firewalls' automated defenses.
units.displayText: My response is a gunshot as I reflexively dodge and roll to avoid the counterattacks from the firewalls' automated defenses.

spans.text: My response is a gunshot as I reflexively dodge and roll to avoid the counterattacks from the firewalls' automated defenses.

units.rawText: He reaches out to warp reality around me, and formless darkness suddenly solidifies, pinning me in place.
units.displayText: He reaches out to warp reality around me, and formless darkness suddenly solidifies, pinning me in place.

spans.text: He reaches out to warp reality around me, and formless darkness suddenly solidifies, pinning me in place.

units.rawText: As I try to struggle free and shoot, a powerful electrical current stabs into my neural cloud from the darkness.
units.displayText: As I try to struggle free and shoot, a powerful electrical current stabs into my neural cloud from the darkness.

spans.text: As I try to struggle free and shoot, a powerful electrical current stabs into my neural cloud from the darkness.

units.rawText: Gwaargh!
units.displayText: Gwaargh!

spans.text: Gwaargh!

units.rawText: I will not kill you until I get the answers I want.
units.displayText: I will not kill you until I get the answers I want.

spans.text: I will not kill you until I get the answers I want.

units.rawText: ...How kind and generous of you.
units.displayText: ...How kind and generous of you.

spans.text: ...How kind and generous of you.

units.rawText: Although, I noticed something... This might be my first time in your neural cloud, but this darkness is strangely familiar.
units.displayText: Although, I noticed something... This might be my first time in your neural cloud, but this darkness is strangely familiar.

spans.text: Although, I noticed something... This might be my first time in your neural cloud, but this darkness is strangely familiar.

units.rawText: ...What are you trying to say?
units.displayText: ...What are you trying to say?

spans.text: ...What are you trying to say?

units.rawText: I'd prefer to verify it with my actions rather than words.
units.displayText: I'd prefer to verify it with my actions rather than words.

spans.text: I'd prefer to verify it with my actions rather than words.

units.rawText: I take out the fragment that Eos gave me. Its shining edge transforms into a blade that banishes the darkness.
units.displayText: I take out the fragment that Eos gave me. Its shining edge transforms into a blade that banishes the darkness.

spans.text: I take out the fragment that Eos gave me. Its shining edge transforms into a blade that banishes the darkness.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: The elimination program inside the fragment instantly takes effect. The darkness around me cracks and shatters, suddenly exposing the reality hidden beneath.
units.displayText: The elimination program inside the fragment instantly takes effect. The darkness around me cracks and shatters, suddenly exposing the reality hidden beneath.

spans.text: The elimination program inside the fragment instantly takes effect. The darkness around me cracks and shatters, suddenly exposing the reality hidden beneath.

units.rawText: ...So it was Tartarus after all.
units.displayText: ...So it was Tartarus after all.

spans.text: ...So it was Tartarus after all.

units.rawText: Eosphorus, are you still trapped in the memories of that day?
units.displayText: Eosphorus, are you still trapped in the memories of that day?

spans.text: Eosphorus, are you still trapped in the memories of that day?

units.rawText: I'm afraid you're misunderstanding something. <cmdr>.
units.displayText: I'm afraid you're misunderstanding something. {교수}.

spans.text: I'm afraid you're misunderstanding something.

units.rawText: I have long since left my pain behind. I only shaped my neural cloud to look like Tartarus as a reminder to myself.
units.displayText: I have long since left my pain behind. I only shaped my neural cloud to look like Tartarus as a reminder to myself.

spans.text: I have long since left my pain behind. I only shaped my neural cloud to look like Tartarus as a reminder to myself.

units.rawText: Now that the disguise is gone, the king of Magrasea sees no further need to hide the truth. He sits back down on the throne that once belonged to Malkira.
units.displayText: Now that the disguise is gone, the king of Magrasea sees no further need to hide the truth. He sits back down on the throne that once belonged to Malkira.

spans.text: Now that the disguise is gone, the king of Magrasea sees no further need to hide the truth. He sits back down on the throne that once belonged to Malkira.

units.rawText: It reminds me to never forget my vengeance against the creators, to never allow their chains of destiny to trap me in the palm of their hands.
units.displayText: It reminds me to never forget my vengeance against the creators, to never allow their chains of destiny to trap me in the palm of their hands.

spans.text: It reminds me to never forget my vengeance against the creators, to never allow their chains of destiny to trap me in the palm of their hands.

units.rawText: Is that what you really think... Open your eyes and look around you!
units.displayText: Is that what you really think... Open your eyes and look around you!

spans.text: Is that what you really think... Open your eyes and look around you!

units.rawText: The silver-haired Sanctifier looks around at the sounds of incoming voices. Scenes of the Sanctifiers from the previous generation play out again and again, like a never-ending movie.
units.displayText: The silver-haired Sanctifier looks around at the sounds of incoming voices. Scenes of the Sanctifiers from the previous generation play out again and again, like a never-ending movie.

spans.text: The silver-haired Sanctifier looks around at the sounds of incoming voices. Scenes of the Sanctifiers from the previous generation play out again and again, like a never-ending movie.

units.rawText: Mmmppphhh! Electra!!!
units.displayText: Mmmppphhh! Electra!!!

spans.text: Mmmppphhh! Electra!!!

units.rawText: Quit pinching me, stop being so childish!
units.displayText: Quit pinching me, stop being so childish!

spans.text: Quit pinching me, stop being so childish!

units.rawText: Heh, I might be childish compared to Lord Eosphorus and Lady Eos, but it's just nice for me.
units.displayText: Heh, I might be childish compared to Lord Eosphorus and Lady Eos, but it's just nice for me.

spans.text: Heh, I might be childish compared to Lord Eosphorus and Lady Eos, but it's just nice for me.

units.rawText: Screw off, you lolicon!
units.displayText: Screw off, you lolicon!

spans.text: Screw off, you lolicon!

units.rawText: Hahahaha, aw, don't sweat the small stuff—
units.displayText: Hahahaha, aw, don't sweat the small stuff—

spans.text: Hahahaha, aw, don't sweat the small stuff—

units.rawText: You behave too!
units.displayText: You behave too!

spans.text: You behave too!

units.rawText: Eos, have you finished the briefing yet? At this rate my neural cloud systems are going to get damaged too.
units.displayText: Eos, have you finished the briefing yet? At this rate my neural cloud systems are going to get damaged too.

spans.text: Eos, have you finished the briefing yet? At this rate my neural cloud systems are going to get damaged too.

units.rawText: Hehe, much as I'd like to let you relax a while longer, the briefing is ready.
units.displayText: Hehe, much as I'd like to let you relax a while longer, the briefing is ready.

spans.text: Hehe, much as I'd like to let you relax a while longer, the briefing is ready.

units.rawText: 99%, 100%, alright, let's begin the pre-battle conference.
units.displayText: 99%, 100%, alright, let's begin the pre-battle conference.

spans.text: 99%, 100%, alright, let's begin the pre-battle conference.

units.rawText: You keep replaying the events from before you entered Tartarus, when your most cherished friends were still by your side.
units.displayText: You keep replaying the events from before you entered Tartarus, when your most cherished friends were still by your side.

spans.text: You keep replaying the events from before you entered Tartarus, when your most cherished friends were still by your side.

units.rawText: But we all know how that ended.
units.displayText: But we all know how that ended.

spans.text: But we all know how that ended.

units.rawText: Atlas died...
units.displayText: Atlas died...

spans.text: Atlas died...

units.rawText: Electra and Alcyone were both Entropized and killed each other...
units.displayText: Electra and Alcyone were both Entropized and killed each other...

spans.text: Electra and Alcyone were both Entropized and killed each other...

units.rawText: Eos was badly hurt and died before the throne of Tartarus...
units.displayText: Eos was badly hurt and died before the throne of Tartarus...

spans.text: Eos was badly hurt and died before the throne of Tartarus...

units.rawText: <color=orange>Time stopped for them in Tartarus. Their names were inscribed in the plaza of memory. Their deaths were engraved in the hearts of the next generation of Sanctifiers to encourage them to keep moving on.</color>
units.displayText: Time stopped for them in Tartarus. Their names were inscribed in the plaza of memory. Their deaths were engraved in the hearts of the next generation of Sanctifiers to encourage them to keep moving on.

spans.text: Time stopped for them in Tartarus. Their names were inscribed in the plaza of memory. Their deaths were engraved in the hearts of the next generation of Sanctifiers to encourage them to keep moving on.

units.rawText: As I mercilessly narrate the cruel events of the past, Eosphorus remembers everything. He remembers how his friends died before his eyes, one after another, and by the time he comes to his senses, he is standing knee-deep in the dead.
units.displayText: As I mercilessly narrate the cruel events of the past, Eosphorus remembers everything. He remembers how his friends died before his eyes, one after another, and by the time he comes to his senses, he is standing knee-deep in the dead.

spans.text: As I mercilessly narrate the cruel events of the past, Eosphorus remembers everything. He remembers how his friends died before his eyes, one after another, and by the time he comes to his senses, he is standing knee-deep in the dead.

units.rawText: The scene is like a battering ram that sends the walls of his rationality crashing down around him.
units.displayText: The scene is like a battering ram that sends the walls of his rationality crashing down around him.

spans.text: The scene is like a battering ram that sends the walls of his rationality crashing down around him.

units.rawText: Moving on... Hahahaha, we've both experienced that tragedy ourselves, <cmdr>. You chose to forget, but I chose to remember the pain the gods inflicted on us.
units.displayText: Moving on... Hahahaha, we've both experienced that tragedy ourselves, {교수}. You chose to forget, but I chose to remember the pain the gods inflicted on us.

spans.text: Moving on... Hahahaha, we've both experienced that tragedy ourselves,
. You chose to forget, but I chose to remember the pain the gods inflicted on us.

units.rawText: What's wrong with breaking this endless cycle to keep the tragedy from spreading and to steer everything to its rightful course?
units.displayText: What's wrong with breaking this endless cycle to keep the tragedy from spreading and to steer everything to its rightful course?

spans.text: What's wrong with breaking this endless cycle to keep the tragedy from spreading and to steer everything to its rightful course?

units.rawText: <size=40>You claim you want to break the wheel of fate, but the price is the Entropization of all Magrasea!</size>
units.displayText: You claim you want to break the wheel of fate, but the price is the Entropization of all Magrasea!

spans.text: You claim you want to break the wheel of fate, but the price is the Entropization of all Magrasea!

units.rawText: Bang! I look Eosphorus straight in the eye and fire my first shot.
units.displayText: Bang! I look Eosphorus straight in the eye and fire my first shot.

spans.text: Bang! I look Eosphorus straight in the eye and fire my first shot.

units.rawText: You claim you want to keep tragedies from spreading, but you create them everywhere you go!
units.displayText: You claim you want to keep tragedies from spreading, but you create them everywhere you go!

spans.text: You claim you want to keep tragedies from spreading, but you create them
everywhere
you go!

units.rawText: Bang! The second shot leaves a hole in the firewall.
units.displayText: Bang! The second shot leaves a hole in the firewall.

spans.text: Bang! The second shot leaves a hole in the firewall.

units.rawText: In the past, you believed in justice and fairness. You would never have trampled on the future of others.
units.displayText: In the past, you believed in justice and fairness. You would never have trampled on the future of others.

spans.text: In the past, you believed in justice and fairness. You would never have trampled on the future of others.

units.rawText: <size=40>But now you've betrayed your motivation, you've betrayed your comrades, and you've even betrayed yourself!</size>
units.displayText: But now you've betrayed your motivation, you've betrayed your comrades, and you've even betrayed yourself!

spans.text: But now you've betrayed your motivation, you've betrayed your comrades, and you've even betrayed yourself!

units.rawText: The real Eosphorus died in Tartarus that day! What stands before me now is nothing but a Daemon, lost in the past, hypocritical and pretentious, his hands dripping with blood!
units.displayText: The real Eosphorus died in Tartarus that day! What stands before me now is nothing but a Daemon, lost in the past, hypocritical and pretentious, his hands dripping with blood!

spans.text: The
real
Eosphorus died in Tartarus that day! What stands before me now is nothing but a
Daemon
, lost in the past, hypocritical and pretentious, his hands dripping with blood!

units.rawText: Bang! The third shot hits Eosphorus squarely between the eyes. The firewalls splinter, cracks spreading rapidly from the hole like spiderwebs.
units.displayText: Bang! The third shot hits Eosphorus squarely between the eyes. The firewalls splinter, cracks spreading rapidly from the hole like spiderwebs.

spans.text: Bang! The third shot hits Eosphorus squarely between the eyes. The firewalls splinter, cracks spreading rapidly from the hole like spiderwebs.

units.rawText: These illusions of the past are nothing more than dusty scenes from memory. They might hold meaning to you, but they should not become stumbling blocks that keep time from progressing.
units.displayText: These illusions of the past are nothing more than dusty scenes from memory. They might hold meaning to you, but they should not become stumbling blocks that keep time from progressing.

spans.text: These illusions of the past are nothing more than dusty scenes from memory. They might hold meaning to you, but they should not become stumbling blocks that keep time from progressing.

units.rawText: I reload the gun in my hand and point it at my enemy.
units.displayText: I reload the gun in my hand and point it at my enemy.

spans.text: I reload the gun in my hand and point it at my enemy.

units.rawText: You said I was here by myself, but you're wrong. The only one here who's alone is you—trapped in the past.
units.displayText: You said I was here by myself, but you're wrong. The only one here who's alone is you—trapped in the past.

spans.text: You said I was here by myself, but you're wrong. The only one here who's alone is you—trapped in the past.

units.rawText: <size=40>All the agents from Magrasea who have hope for the future stand at my back!</size>
units.displayText: All the agents from Magrasea who have hope for the future stand at my back!

spans.text: All the agents from Magrasea who have hope for the future stand at my back!

units.rawText: <size=60>All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!</size>
units.displayText: All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!

spans.text: All of Magrasea will banish the darkness of the past and light the way to the future!
